f4b4bb981e:abb39fac635e1988.title: BLASTEMA
f4b4bb981e:abb39fac635e1988.summary: A blastema is the tissue a body forms to regenerate something it has lost. It is made up of progenitor cells capable, for a time, of changing state and giving rise to something else. They don't have a fixed form yet. They are going to become something different. This project starts there and pushes the idea into a place where biology no longer applies: insects whose tissue, instead of regenerating as insects, begins to behave like plant matter. Lichens, moss, mycelium, fungal fruiting bodies. They are not placed on top. They grow from the same tissue, as if the cell had switched sides. The process: each specimen begins as an image, is reconstructed in 3D, and ultimately becomes a Gaussian Splat rendered in real time through our own GLSL shaders. This is where it truly comes alive. It is no longer a fixed model, but a structure that scatters light and changes according to the viewpoint.

a4977d3fa4:5e1351cea850e826.title: True Religion Threw the Hottest Party of NYFW, Proving the Y2K Revival Isn’t Going Anywhere
a4977d3fa4:5e1351cea850e826.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5e1351cea850e826.summary: If your fashion week feed felt like a massive blast from the past, you can thank True Religion. The iconic denim brand completely took over Flyfish for their “Iconography: That Was Then, This Is Now” event, effectively throwing the most talked-about party of New York Fashion Week. Blending nostalgic early-2000s energy with today’s top tastemakers, the night felt like a cultural handoff between the icons who built the Y2K aesthetic and the modern creators keeping it alive.The energy inside was unmatched, largely because the guest list read like a who’s who of music, sports, and internet culture. Attendees wandering through the crowd might have spotted Afrobeats star Davido, creative Julez Smith, the Combs Twins, content creator Azzy Milan, or UFC legend Tyron Woodley. Between mixing drinks and checking out the scene, guests also got an exclusive peek at a gifting suite stacked with new pieces from True Religion’s Fall ‘26 Iconography Capsule the very line recently brought to life by campaign stars like Cash Cobain who was in the building alongside fellow heavyweights like Dave East, A Boogie wit da Hoodie, and Trinidad James, Shenseea, Shareef, Shaqir, and Myles O’Neal.What really set the night apart, though, was the music. DJ Chron kept the room moving throughout the evening, with DJ MOS dropping in for a guest set—an effortless meeting of eras that matched the energy in the room. Dess Dior set the tone early with a high-energy performance, while Joey Bada$$ pulled up fresh off his sold-out run at the Blue Note. Then Fabolous surprised the crowd with an unannounced set. Just when the night seemed to have peaked, Ja Rule joined Fab at the DJ booth for “Ride for This,” sending the packed room into full nostalgia mode.Beyond the star power, there was a surprisingly deep layer of New York history embedded into the night. Twenty-five years ago, spirit brand Hpnotiq was set to launch as the sponsor for Fabolous’ debut album party, an event that ultimately never…

a4977d3fa4:7bb171b495f8c10d.title: 'Something's Off' — And That's the Point: Mowalola Brings Her Unapologetic Vision to Jordan Brand
a4977d3fa4:7bb171b495f8c10d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:7bb171b495f8c10d.summary: Summary Mowalola x Jordan Brand officially launches with the 'Something's Off' campaign shot by Norbert Schoerner.The collection expands on the previously teased Air Jordan 14 and new Air Jordan 14 Mule, adding oversized leather jackets, tartan tracksuits, vests, and Jordan-branded microshorts. The Mowalola x Jordan Brand collection launches on Mowalola's website on September 19, with a global release on September 26. Mowalola Ogunlesi’s namesake label’s long-awaited Air Jordan collaboration is officially launching this month, and in preparation, Mowalola tapped famed photographer and filmmaker Norbert Schoerner to shoot the visuals for the 'Something’s Off' campaign. The Nigerian-born designer's résumé of collaborations already spans Marc Jacobs bags, Ksubi cheetah print jackets, Skateroom decks, and Beats by Dre headphones. However, Mowalola strived for a long-term partnership — arriving at Jordan Brand x Mowalola, the designer’s eponymous label’s partnership with Nike’s iconic basketball line.Mowalola x Air Jordan was first teased back in early June, when Ogunlesi unveiled her take on the Air Jordan 14 silhouette, reimagined in burgundy suede, alongside a brand-new metallic backless version, the Air Jordan 14 Mule, finished in aged leather uppers. True to Mowalola’s intentional world-building and her unapologetic vision, the 'Something’s Off' campaign pushes boundaries and presents a singular perspective on the Jordan Brand iconography. The collaboration now unfolds as a full collection featuring oversized leather jackets, translucent tartan tracksuits, fitted vests, and Jordan-branded signature Mowalola microshorts worn by model Alek Wek, musicians Chxrry and Tezzus, and rapper Pz' in eerie, uncanny scenes around an abandoned hotel. The Mowalola x Jordan Brand collection drops on Mowalola's website on Saturday, September 19, with a global release following on Saturday, September 26. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:898030b9a6f6425c.title: James Turrell Opens New Miami-Inspired Installation at Superblue
a4977d3fa4:898030b9a6f6425c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:898030b9a6f6425c.summary: Summary Light and space luminary James Turrell has unveiled a new commission, "Blue Sea Sky," at Superblue MiamiPart of his famed 'Ganzfeld' series, the installation translates the hues of Miami — its beaches, flora, and architecture — into immersive fields of lightThe artwork challenges our perception of reality through uniform fields of light, depth, and distance James Turrell lifted the veil on a new installation at Superblue Miami. The first release hot off the largest-ever Skyspace in Denmark, "Blue Sea Sky" arrives as the latest Ganzfeld installation, created in response to the sumptuous shorelines nearby.As with all of Turrell’s Ganzfeld pieces, the installation works through its namesake ganzfeld effect: white rooms are soaked in uniform fields of light, overwhelming viewers' perception of distance and depth. Subtle shifts in levels and hue confuse perceptual reality into surreal experiences of light and space.The new commission replaces “AKHU,” another Ganzfeld installation that inaugurated the institution in 2021. In place of the first loan's rich jewel tones, the colors of “Blue Sea Sky” were specifically modeled after those of South Florida. Aquatic blues drawn from the sea fade into palm greens, peachy sunset oranges, and playful pinks inspired by neon signs and Art Deco architecture mounted around the city.“‘Blue Sea Sky’ brings people together in a shared experience of immersion in pure color, pushing the limits of human perception,” Dent-Brocklehurst, Superblue’s chief curator, penned in a statement. “It’s difficult to speak about Turrell without including one of his own wonderful quotes. Of the many, the following is perhaps my favorite: ‘In an age of consumerism and materialism, I traffic in blue sky and colored air.’”The installation is now on view in Miami.Superblue Miami1101 NW 23rd St,Miami, FL 33127 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:e6b977cf7e1a1642.title: LUAR’s Worlds Collide in “Christopher Street Columbus” SS27
a4977d3fa4:e6b977cf7e1a1642.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e6b977cf7e1a1642.summary: On September 14, LUAR took over the iconic Unisphere outside of the Queens Museum to show its SS27 collection, “Christopher Street Columbus.” Exploring the history embedded in Raul Lopez’s Carribean heritage and the designer's formative years on Christopher Street, where he delved into the queer nightlife scene, the collection continued to develop LUAR’s subversive aesthetic with ever more refinement. Lit up beneath the evening sky, the outdoor runway encircled the massive Unisphere, and the show began just as the sun dipped past the horizon. The landmark location only added to the collection’s grandeur, which traversed experimental tailoring, clubwear, and elegant gowns. The first looks that appeared were some of the most pared-back, yet Lopez still found new ways to remix recognizable staples. A gray double-breasted suit was styled with voluminous Spanish breeches, recalling depictions of Spanish voyagers, and a minimal black suit with a standing collar featured dramatic white lace cuffs peeking through. As the show progressed, the Spanish breeches continued in varying lengths and fabrics, intermixing with city staples, including a range of black leather motorcycle jackets and crocodile-embossed pieces like trucker jackets and jeans. Handbags, among Luar’s signature strengths, mirrored the fabric treatments of the garments, including reptile textures, faded leathers, a bright blue velvet, and more.Debuting alongside Lopez’s SS27 range was the highly limited LUAR x Lunazul clothing collection — a seamless fusion of LUAR’s NYC nightlife-inspired aesthetic with Lunazul’s expertise in crafting tequila. Uniting around their mutual dedication to craftsmanship, the collection features a two-piece denim set, and a classic baseball cap. The look orbits around a plant-based agave leather in striking Lunazul blue, representing their shared lunar muse against the night sky. Ahead of the presentation, Lopez mused, "Taking an iconic plant like agave, turning it into vegan…

a4977d3fa4:f7c9587753de7343.title: Inside Hypebeast Afterhours: A Sandy Liang NYFW Afterparty
a4977d3fa4:f7c9587753de7343.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:f7c9587753de7343.summary: On the evening of Sunday, September 13, as the New York Fashion Week festivities continued, Hypebeast took over the intimate rooftop garden of Ludlow House in Manhattan’s Lower East Side for “Hypebeast Afterhours with Sandy Liang”. The party marked the debut of her Spring/Summer 2027 collection, which had closed out on the runway at Petzel Gallery in Chelsea just hours earlier, giving guests barely enough time to trade their seats for cocktails before funneling into the top floor of the former gold leaf factory.Throughout the evening, Japanese whisky brand House of Suntory mixed special drinks featuring the Suntory Toki, a smooth, versatile blended whisky. While guests sipped on highballs and sours, New York City-based DJ Emily Yun and DJ, producer, and multidisciplinary artist Lumia were behind the decks, keeping the crowd hypnotized with her electronic, bassline-driven sound.Dressed in pastel, silky, and sporty pieces from the newest collection, the designer’s inner circle showed out to celebrate a collection that filtered girlhood through utility, with fantasy stitched into function. Stacked with friends, family, and collaborators, the guest list included Devon Lee Carlson, Yoon Ahn, Dean DiCriscio, Jordan Daniels, Kelsey Calemine, Maria Alia, Noor Elkhaldi, Jeremyn Lee, and Sandy Liang herself.By the end of the night, "Hypebeast Afterhours with Sandy Liang" had done exactly what it set out to do — extend the energy of her standout NYFW show into a celebration built around the same spirit as the collection itself. The rooftop became proof that Sandy Liang’s Spring/Summer 2027 vision wasn't confined to the runway, but lived on in every corner of Ludlow House. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:25ef5c4f0087764d.title: A First Look at LUAR & Lunazul Tequila’s Agave-Infused Capsule
a4977d3fa4:25ef5c4f0087764d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:25ef5c4f0087764d.summary: The merging of worlds, integral to LUAR’s cross-cultural ethos, continues in a new partnership between Raul Lopez’s label and Lunazul Tequila. In this consciously crafted, moonlit collection, the designer’s bold city essence goes hand in hand with the tequila maker’s foundations in the growing and distilling of blue weber agave. The official lookbook offers a first glimpse of this extremely limited fusion of creative imprints — a collaboration that only manifests “Once in a Lunazul”.The city-inspired silhouettes, comprising a two-piece denim set, a classic baseball cap, and a basketball-shaped bag, tie LUAR’s signature NYC aesthetic with Lunazul’s craft-driven approach to tequila. Lunazul brings its identity into the mix through its signature blue hue, found in the stitching and agave leather details. With a mastery of agave cultivation spanning more than seven generations, the core element of Lunazul’s hand-harvested, handcrafted tequila shares its basic foundations with this innovative plant-based leather.The broader collection orbits around the handbag, characterized by a blue agave leather shell and a subtle LUAR logo at the front. With its organic shape and bright hue, the bag serves as a perfect accent to the black denim set, which boasts a co-branded agave leather collar and patches on the back of each piece. The denim number comprises a classic trucker jacket accentuated by blue contrast stitching, and wide-leg shorts with matching details. Worn together, the look has the relaxed elegance of a classic dark-wash denim set, steeped in the auratic glow of a moonlit night.Shot on the streets of Lower Manhattan and in a blue agave field, the lookbook ties the foundations of LUAR and Lunazul together just as each style from the collection does on its own. LUAR x Lunazul’s exclusive collaborative range will officially debut at LUAR’s SS27 runway presentation on September 14, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:b6e49f4c20af3f71.title: Kevin Hart Is All In on Golf
a4977d3fa4:b6e49f4c20af3f71.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b6e49f4c20af3f71.summary: Watching Kevin Hart on set is akin to watching a veteran fighter in the ring. There's efficiency to everything he does. At a shoot in South Brooklyn, he transitions from still photography to a scripted commercial to short-form social without ever losing momentum. Someone steps in, gives him the brief and Hart takes it from there as he riffs, adjusts and delivers with the composure of someone who has done this thousands of times. Because, of course, he has.It's an appropriate way to encounter Hart at this particular moment. At 46, after a career built around comedy, entertainment, business and a relentless commitment to fitness, he has thrown himself headfirst into something he is decidedly less experienced at: golf.What began less than a year ago has quickly become another obsession. Hart has joined a growing group of high-profile athletes and entertainers taking up the game, traded playful challenges with LeBron James and even appeared at Augusta National during Masters week. Now golf is becoming part of his business world, too, as Fabletics expands into the category with a collection shaped in part by Hart's own rapid immersion in the sport.That's what brought us to the course in Brooklyn: to talk about why golf took hold so quickly, how his instinct for self-improvement translates to a game built on frustration and what happens when someone accustomed to mastering his craft willingly puts himself back in the position of being a beginner.Hypegolf: We know you’ve been getting into golf recently. Once you got into golf, what was the moment you realized that this was becoming more than a hobby for you?Kevin Hart: Probably when I took a liking to it. I'm pretty obsessive, so if I take a liking to anything, it's very hard for me to approach it halfway. It's kind of all or nothing. And the idea of a game that puts you in a position where you're just competing against yourself is fun. It's exciting to also suck and know that you can only get better. So I think that was…

a4977d3fa4:a689c18b3baf1062.title: Toronto Raptors Officially Acquire Kawhi Leonard in Blockbuster Trade With Clippers
a4977d3fa4:a689c18b3baf1062.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:a689c18b3baf1062.summary: Summary The Toronto Raptors have officially re-acquired Kawhi Leonard from the Los Angeles Clippers following NBA trade approvalToronto traded Brandon Ingram Gradey Dick three first-round pick assets and two second-round picks to Los AngelesThe deal was finalized after an NBA investigation into salary-cap circumvention resulted in fines and executive suspensions for the Clippers The Toronto Raptors have officially acquired Kawhi Leonard from the Los Angeles Clippers following trade approval from the NBA on September 14, 2026. The transaction brings the 2019 NBA champion back to Toronto after a months-long league investigation into salary-cap circumvention delayed the deal.To acquire Leonard, the Raptors sent All-Star forward Brandon Ingram, guard Gradey Dick, unprotected first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, a 2027 first-round pick swap, and two second-round picks to Los Angeles. The trade was cleared following the conclusion of an NBA inquiry on September 2, which fined Leonard $700,000 USD while levying a $30 million USD fine, a five-pick draft penalty, and executive suspensions against the Clippers organization.Leonard returns to Toronto after a 2025-26 campaign with the Clippers where he averaged 27.9 points, 6.3 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 1.9 steals per game. The seven-time All-Star and two-time NBA champion joins a Raptors squad that finished fifth in defensive rating last season, bolstering the franchise's defensive core and championship aspirations.Kawhi Leonard is expected to speak with reporters on September 28, 2026, during Toronto's official media day. a4977d3fa4:5954a48959096aea.title: Ford Files Patent for a System That Moves a Parked Truck Using Its Tailgate Handle
a4977d3fa4:5954a48959096aea.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5954a48959096aea.summary: Summary Ford Global Technologies secures a patent allowing pickup trucks to be moved from the outside via the tailgate handleThe push-to-move system lets operators inch a vehicle forward or backward to assist with exterior workSafety features like a dead-man switch and parking sensors ensure intentional, incident-free operation Ford Global Technologies has officially secured U.S. patent #12,728,722, introducing a control mechanism designed to let operators move a stationary pickup truck without entering the cab. Officially titled "Systems and methods for moving a vehicle using externally mounted HMI," the documentation outlines a physical interface that provides a manual solution for interacting with a stationary rig. This filing prioritizes a functional fix for inching a vehicle along during manual labor.At the core of the newly patented system is the physical pop-up grab handle situated at the rear of the pickup. This component is currently an optional part of the tailgate step on Ford F-series trucks, but the patent gives it movement functionality. Under this design, the operator pushes on the rear handle to request movement, prompting the stationary pickup truck to move forward or backward in small increments. The mechanism is responsive to human input, meaning that pushing harder on the handle could cause the truck to travel a farther distance. Alternatively, applying harder pressure to the handle could deliver a rapid series of more frequent, equal-size nudges. Operation is fully bidirectional and works just as seamlessly in reverse.Handing control of a multi-ton pickup to an operator standing outside the cab requires safety countermeasures. Documentation for the Ford patent notes that onboard parking sensors, alongside monitoring systems, track surroundings to prevent incidents at either end of the vehicle. To eliminate the risk of an accidental activation, the system could be programmed to move the truck only after the operator deliberately applies…

a4977d3fa4:625a04ac48dd59d1.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:625a04ac48dd59d1.summary: Summary Valve's Steam Frame is a wireless, streaming-first VR headset and controller set built to run the entire Steam libraryThe headset pairs custom pancake lenses with dual 2160x2160 LCD panels, a 72 to 144Hz refresh range and a 4nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processorNew Foveated Streaming and Multi-Link Streaming features use eye tracking and multiple connections to boost image quality and stability Valve has introduced the Steam Frame, a wireless VR headset and controller kit engineered to play a user's whole Steam library, in VR, in flatscreen and increasingly standalone. Positioned as a streaming-first device within the Steam Hardware family, it leans on a mix of custom optics, on-board processing and new eye-tracking-driven streaming tech to hold a stable, high-quality connection without cables or setup.The optics and display do the heavy lifting on immersion. Thin, lightweight custom pancake lenses deliver edge-to-edge sharpness and a large eye box, sitting in front of dual LCD panels running 2160x2160 per eye. Supported refresh rates span 72 to 144Hz, with 144Hz listed as experimental. Tracking runs inside-out with no setup required, using four high-resolution monochrome cameras plus infrared illuminators so the system holds up even in dark rooms.Under the hood, the Steam Frame is effectively a PC. It runs SteamOS 3 on a 4nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (ARM64) paired with 16GB of unified LPDDR5X RAM, backed by 256GB or 1TB of UFS storage and a microSD slot for expansion. That hardware is what enables standalone play on a growing list of VR and non-VR titles without a host PC, and it brings SteamOS staples like quick suspend and resume, cloud saves, a browser and user-installed apps into the headset itself. A Steam Frame Standalone Verified program flags which library games run locally, while a developer kit program aims to widen compatibility through Proton and SteamOS.The streaming architecture is where Valve concentrated its engineering. a4977d3fa4:891e4341224cc063.summary: The adidas Samba is a masterclass in unintentional reinvention. Originally engineered in 1950 by Adi Dassler at adidas to provide traction for German football players navigating rock-hard, frozen pitches, the silhouette has transcended its utilitarian roots to become the defining fashion sneaker of the 2020s. Selling over 35 million pairs since its inception, the Samba’s journey from a rugged athletic tool to a runway staple is a testament to the power of subcultural adoption and perfectly executed collaborative design.The Milestones That Shaped a PhenomenonThe trajectory of the Samba from sports gear to a ubiquitous street-style staple was driven by organic adoption across distinct cultural eras rather than a single marketing campaign. It began in the 1950s as a purely functional piece of equipment, engineered by Adi Dassler with kangaroo leather and an innovative gum sole equipped with suction-cup-like lugs to keep German footballers upright on frozen pitches. As the game evolved, the shoe followed suit. By the 1970s, the Samba was relaunched to dominate the indoor soccer and futsal revolution, featuring enhanced multi-directional grip, a three-zone side profile, and a reinforced suede T-toe vamp built to withstand aggressive ball handling.The silhouette's leap from the court to the streets took hold in the 1980s across the UK. Die-hard football fans, known as casuals, adopted the Samba as a staple of their unofficial uniform. Paired with designer tracksuits, Stone Island jackets, and Fred Perry polos, the sneaker became a badge of honor on the stadium terraces, effectively bridging the gap between sportswear and subcultural identity. In the 1990s, skateboarders naturally gravitated toward the model for its unparalleled board feel, low profile, and durable leather construction. This grassroots skate adoption was so impactful it eventually led adidas to develop dedicated skate models like the Busenitz and the Samba ADV.The ultimate high-fashion renaissance…

a4977d3fa4:4e5c71342bae0701.title: Public School SS27 'LIVING PROOF' Is a Survey of the City in Motion
a4977d3fa4:4e5c71342bae0701.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:4e5c71342bae0701.summary: Summary Public School New York's SS27 collection, 'LIVING PROOF', marks its second NYFW show since returning after seven years, evolving from FW26's homecoming into "a dialogue in modularity."Natural and technical fabrics combine in a navy, black, grey, and stone palette built for urban camouflage and readiness.Structured shoulders, waterproof galoshes, peel-away layers, and cross-body straps highlight Public School's roots as a New York story. On Thursday, September 10, Public School New York, the influential label by Maxwell Osborne and Dao-Yi Chow, presented its second collection since returning to the runway after seven years during NYFW at Gotham Hall in Manhattan's Midtown. Titled ‘LIVING PROOF,’ the Spring/Summer 2027 collection builds on the momentum of the brand's Fall/Winter 2026 comeback, framing this season’s collection as a survey of familiar territory reimagined for what lies ahead.Where the Fall/Winter 2026 collection titled ‘Everything is Now' marked a homecoming, the ‘LIVING PROOF’ collection leans into evolution, described by the designers as "a dialogue in modularity" that prepares the wearer for whatever elements city living may bring. The collection draws on a wide range of materials, including natural wools, baby ribbed cotton, yarn-dyed cupro, viscose, and cashmere cottons, juxtaposed with washed synthetics and ripstop nylon, all designed with readiness in uncertain times in mind. The color palette is precise — navy, black, greys, and stone — mixed and matched for urban camouflage, letting the wearer blend in while staying active. ‘LIVING PROOF’ dissects what a “uniform” becomes when school is no longer the classroom, but the world before us. Broad, structured shoulders nod to Public School's signature silhouette while doubling as protection against wind and rain. Waterproof galoshes cover a new footwear lineup featuring exaggerated toe springs for forward motion, while woven shirts layered with soft jerseys create body wraps that add…

a4977d3fa4:5e8bf64cde843fef.title: Alice Diop to Curate Miu Miu’s 2026 Art Basel Paris Show
a4977d3fa4:5e8bf64cde843fef.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5e8bf64cde843fef.summary: Summary French filmmaker Alice Diop is the recipient of Miu Miu's 2026 commission for the Art Basel Paris Public Program Diop will premiere her first exhibition, "Geste de Consolation (Gesture of Consolation)," during the fair in OctoberAlongside her own work, Diop has curated a selection of pieces by artists that inspire her, including Zanele Muholi, Mary Lee Bendolph, Simone Leigh, and more French filmmaker Alice Diop is up next for Miu Miu’s Art Basel Paris public program next month, marking her first-ever exhibition.The project, called “Geste de Consolation (Gesture of Consolation),” is billed as “a celebratory chorus of Black creativity,” per a press statement. The exhibition will transform Palais d’Iéna — home to France’s Economic, Social and Environmental Council and Miu Miu’s runway shows — with a “montage" of film, photography, sculpture, poetry, dance, music, and performance.Building on “Fragments for Venus,” her 2025 short for Miu Miu Women Tales, Diop’s upcoming show explores how representations of Black women through history have shaped today’s politics of looking, gathering contributions by those that have artistically "nourished her": South African photographer Zanele Muholi, Gee’s Bend quilter Mary Lee Bendolph, sculptor Simone Leigh, composer Angel Bat Dawid, and all-woman jazz trio Sistazz of the Nitty-Gritty.“I want my curation to center on acts of consolation conceived by Black women artists, each active in their own discipline, to repair the fetishizing gaze to which centuries of art history have confined us, ” she said.Of the four environments on view is a living room and library installation, carpeted in motifs by Bendolph, featuring her favorite books. Another room, a screening space, presents a montage of archival film and image excerpts that have shaped her gaze as a filmmaker.This is the third Miu Miu-backed exhibition at the French mega-fair since the two launched a public program partnership in 2024. Diop is the third artist chosen by…

a4977d3fa4:a348ba72d6c46bb1.title: Aries FW26 Drags Early-2000s Luxury Through Acid-Washed Corduroy and Snakeskin
a4977d3fa4:a348ba72d6c46bb1.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:a348ba72d6c46bb1.summary: Summary Aries has introduced its FW26 collection under the title "Faded Opulence," built on fabrications that have been sun-faded, washed and distressedA washed snakeskin print lands on the new lower-rise Lilly jean, which the label has positioned as the hero denim silhouette of the seasonAlpha Industries joins the collection with a reworked CWU-45 Heritage bomber finished with studded hardware Aries has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, "Faded Opulence," a season that puts luxury materials through the wringer and then treats the damage as the point. The London-based label frames the range around early-2000s excess colliding with derelict Baroque interiors, lush animal skins and the residue of it all, and delivers that idea through surface treatment rather than silhouette. Every rich texture here has been degraded in some way, sun-faded or washed or distressed until the polish reads as residue.Denim carries the clearest statement. The Lilly jean returns with a lower rise and arrives in a washed snakeskin print, designated by the brand as the hero denim style of FW26. It anchors a broader run of animal-print work that includes distorted zebra graphics across knitwear and warped animal prints applied to Airtex and jersey hoodies and sweatpants.The texture list is unusually specific for a streetwear season. Acid-washed corduroy, chenille knitwear and washed denim set the lived-in baseline, while sun-bleached jersey finished with diamantés supplies the glint of ruined glamour. Slick snakeskin, glossy leather and sheepskin raise the register at the top end, the three materials that push the collection furthest into what Aries describes as worn glamour.Founded by Sofia Prantera on a diet of trash culture, outsider art and bold graphics, Aries treats its archive as working material rather than heritage to be preserved, and the FW26 artwork reads as a survey of that instinct. New iterations of Aries and Destroy, Smoking Tiger and Cave appear across Airtex and…

a4977d3fa4:8d019768ae82711b.title: Sound & Sole: Lost Frequencies, Miss Monique, and NOVAH Lace Up the Tomorrowland WR1
a4977d3fa4:8d019768ae82711b.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:8d019768ae82711b.summary: There's a version of Tomorrowland that ends when the last set does — the grounds emptied, the stages struck, the weekend folded into memory. And then there's the version the festival has spent fifteen years building in the other direction: out past the gates, into fragrances and homeware and, now, footwear. The WR1 is the festival's first-ever sneaker, unveiled at Tomorrowland Belgium 2026 ahead of a global release this September. A sculptural, nature-referencing runner — its flowing lines and layered sole drawn from the geometry of a dragonfly's wing and the patterns inside a mushroom's gills — it's pitched less as merch than as something you carry with you long after the music stops. Which is a fitting brief for the three artists chosen to front it, all of whom spend their lives moving between worlds and trying to leave something behind in each one.For Lost Frequencies, the collaboration lands close to home. Felix De Laet has spent the better part of a decade at the top of melodic dance, and he grew up in Belgium knowing the festival long before he ever played it. "Tomorrowland has always felt very close to home for me," he says — which is part of why its first step into footwear "feels really special," especially watching a brand he's close to push beyond the festival itself. His days rarely repeat: studio one morning, an unfamiliar city the next, a crowd of thousands by night. He traces that restlessness straight into the music, drawn to the contrast "between something emotional and intimate and something that can suddenly feel huge on a dancefloor." Longevity, he reckons, is mostly curiosity — constant digging, new edits, unreleased tests, no two sets ever quite alike. Ask what should be playing the first time you lace up a pair and he doesn't hesitate: "Live It All," a track built to move to that keeps an emotional undertow, "a good soundtrack for putting on a new pair of shoes and heading out with no real idea where the night is going to take you."Miss…

a4977d3fa4:8e1c75a6c5a4bb2c.title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week
a4977d3fa4:8e1c75a6c5a4bb2c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:8e1c75a6c5a4bb2c.summary: Summary Palace Skateboards and Avirex return with a co-branded capsule built around a tracksuit, three jersey options and two headwear stylesOversized branding is applied across multiple placements on every piece in the rangeThe collection follows the heavyweight A-2 leather flying jacket that anchored the first drop Palace Skateboards and Avirex have reunited for a second co-branded collection, this time trading outerwear for a head-to-toe sportswear offering. Where the opening chapter centered on a single statement jacket, the new capsule spreads across a tracksuit, a run of jersey pieces and a pair of accessories, with scaled-up logo work tying the whole thing together.The tracksuit leads the range, joined by jersey options that cover a hooded sweatshirt plus long and short sleeve tees. Accessories round things out with a no-cuff beanie and a cap, giving the capsule a full top-to-bottom spread rather than a single hero piece.Branding does the heavy lifting throughout. Rather than keeping logos to a chest hit, both labels have blown up their marks and scattered them across several placements on each garment, a treatment that carries consistently from the tracksuit through to the headwear.That approach reads as a deliberate counterpoint to drop one. The first release hinged on Avirex's A-2 leather flying jacket, cut from rich pebbled leather in the boxed-out shape that defined the outfitter's 2000s output. Where that piece earned its weight through material, this second wave leans on cut and graphic scale instead, translating the same boxy proportions into knit and jersey fabrications.The Avirex x Palace Skateboards capsule launches Friday, September 18 at 11:00 a.m. BST across the UK, Europe and the US, followed by Saturday, September 19 at 11:00 a.m. local time in Japan, China, Korea and Australia. a4977d3fa4:4ca0deb4b9d26dfb.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Becomes Universal Pictures' Highest-Grossing Film of All Time
a4977d3fa4:4ca0deb4b9d26dfb.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:4ca0deb4b9d26dfb.summary: Summary Universal Pictures has announced that Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' is officially the highest-grossing film in the studio's historyThe feature film has generated $601.2 million USD domestically alongside $1.083 billion USD in international ticket salesThe Matt Damon-led epic reached the historic $1.68 billion USD worldwide milestone in less than two months Universal Pictures and director Christopher Nolan have reached a historic milestone with The Odyssey, officially making it the highest-grossing film in the studio’s 114-year history. Starring Matt Damon, the epic has grossed $601.2 million USD domestically and $1.083 billion USD internationally, bringing its worldwide box office total to $1.68 billion USD.Produced by Emma Thomas and Nolan via their Syncopy banner alongside executive producer Thomas Hayslip, the film reclaimed the top box office spot in its eighth weekend in theaters. The project marks the largest opening of Nolan’s career, surpassing The Dark Knight Rises to become his highest-grossing movie to date. NBCUniversal Entertainment chairman Donna Langley lauded the release as an ambitious generational event for cinema.In addition to becoming Universal's top earner, the film has set several global superlatives, standing as the highest-grossing R-rated film in history and the top-earning release for IMAX. Based on 3,000-year-old source material, the project is also the first non-sequel film to cross $1 billion USD overseas since 2009, capping a milestone partnership following Nolan's 2021 move to Universal. a4977d3fa4:ce1dbb68aa4a76d2.title: TSTS's ‘The Wizard of Oz’ Tote Stacks Rhinestones Over a Printed Canvas Body
a4977d3fa4:ce1dbb68aa4a76d2.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:ce1dbb68aa4a76d2.summary: Summary TSTS has produced a limited-run Wizard of Oz tote bag built on a canvas body finished with a special printRhinestones are layered over that print so the surface throws off the red shine of the film's magic shoesThe bag arrives alongside the brand's FW26 collection "The Saxe Blue Gingham," an official Wizard of Oz collaboration TSTS has made a Wizard of Oz tote bag, and the construction is more involved than the format suggests. The bag starts from a canvas body carrying a special print, then adds a second pass of rhinestones set over the printed surface, a stacking technique that gives the graphic physical relief rather than leaving it flat. The effect the brand is chasing is the red glint of the film's magic shoes.The tote is a special item produced for the occasion rather than a general release, and it is being made in limited numbers. It belongs to a wider Wizard of Oz collaboration series that TSTS has developed into "The Saxe Blue Gingham," the brand's FW26 collection, which puts the film's iconography into the label's own vocabulary.That vocabulary is gingham. The check is TSTS's brand signature, and pieces built on it are being carried alongside the collaboration items, which places the Oz material and the house pattern in the same room for the first time. The pairing also explains the collection's name, with the saxe blue reading as a color direction rather than a graphic one.The bag itself is the most technically involved piece in the mix. Canvas is a deliberately plain base, and the decision to print it first and then bead over the print means the shine sits proud of the fabric rather than being simulated in ink.The Wizard of Oz tote is available at the TSTS pop-up store, held in the 1F POP UP SPACE "GATE" at Shibuya PARCO from September 15 through September 23, and through the TSTS Online Store. a4977d3fa4:8cc99aaf28f4648e.summary: Summary thisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have built a joint collection that reinterprets the apple motif and other artworks from UNDERCOVER's graphic archiveThe lineup is led by a washed denim down jacket and a jacquard zip-up hoodie, backed by denim pants and graphic T-shirtsA run of accessories rounds out the collaboration, which opens in Tokyo this week before reaching Seoul in December thisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have put together a collaborative collection, and the pieces are worth getting specific about. The Seoul label has taken UNDERCOVER's signature apple motif along with a broader set of artworks and run them through its own lens, rather than simply reprinting them at scale. The result covers outerwear, denim, jersey and accessories, with the heaviest construction saved for the top of the range.The anchor piece is a washed denim down jacket, a combination that asks the denim to carry a baffled insulated build while the wash treatment keeps the surface broken in rather than rigid. Sitting beside it is a jacquard zip-up hoodie, where the graphics are woven into the fabric structure itself instead of being applied on top, which is the more labor-intensive route to a motif and the one that holds up better over repeat wears.From there the collection works down through the wardrobe. Denim pants extend the material story from the jacket, graphic T-shirts carry the artwork in its most direct form, and a range of accessories completes the offering. Across all of it, the apple sits as the recurring device, reframed through thisisneverthat's own graphic sensibility.The thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER collection drops Friday, September 18 at 5 p.m. JST, available exclusively at the thisisneverthat Shibuya Flagship. A pop-up follows at the thisisneverthat Seongsu Flagship in Seoul this December. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:50bd806e1db0c775.title: Apple Is Reportedly Working on Beats-Branded iPhone Game Controllers
a4977d3fa4:50bd806e1db0c775.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:50bd806e1db0c775.summary: Summary Apple develops two first-party game controllers for the iPhoneHardware launches under the Beats brand rather than the main Apple lineupLower price points and lifestyle branding target a wider gaming audience Apple is supposedly developing two first-party iPhone game controllers to expand its mobile hardware ecosystem. Joe Rossignol reported the discovery on September 13, after finding references in the macOS 26.7 operating system code. Mark Gurman later confirmed that the hardware targets iPhone users despite the discovery in Mac software. Internal code identifies these devices as first-party products.The tech giant plans to release the hardware under the Beats brand to reach a different market demographic. Beats executives lead the development process according to reporting by Gurman. This move follows recent brand expansions into lifestyle accessories like phone cases and charging cables.iPhone game controllers released under this banner allow for more aggressive pricing. Manufacturers avoid the high-end finishes and premium materials found on mainline Apple products to lower costs. Lower price points help the company target a broader audience of mobile gamers.Using the subsidiary as an incubator lets the parent company test new categories without risking its flagship luxury status. Gaming culture fits the Beats lifestyle image better than the minimalist aesthetic of standard Mac accessories. These iPhone game controllers establish a first-party presence in a market previously served by third-party peripheral manufacturers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:d7d15d5a74f1bc79.title: Burger King's "Le Nugguette" Is a Nugget-Sized Micro-Bag With a Sauce Charm Inside
a4977d3fa4:d7d15d5a74f1bc79.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:d7d15d5a74f1bc79.summary: Summary Burger King has produced Le Nugguette, a limited-edition micro-bag sized to a single chicken nugget and released during fashion seasonEvery bag ships with one of four sauce-inspired charms, covering Special Savory, Honey Mustard, Buffalo and Sweet & SourEach unit also includes a redeemable code for a four-piece serving of the chain's new chicken nuggets Burger King has made a bag, and it is roughly the size of a chicken nugget. Le Nugguette is a limited-edition micro-bag built to mark the chain's new nuggets, which rolled out nationwide earlier this month alongside an updated sauce lineup. The object itself is the point: a miniature carry scaled down past the threshold of practicality, timed to land while fashion season is in full swing.The detailing is where the bag does its work. Each Le Nugguette arrives with one of four charms modeled on the new sauces, covering Special Savory, Honey Mustard, Buffalo and Sweet & Sour, which turns the release into a set with four possible outcomes rather than a single uniform item. The bag also comes packed with a redeemable code good for a four-piece order of the nuggets, so the accessory and the product it advertises travel together.Burger King has been direct about the intent behind the object. "As we launch our new, high-quality Nuggets, we wanted to have some fun and bring fashion and food together," said Allison Smith, Vice President of Marketing Communications for Burger King US&C, in a statement.Le Nugguette is available exclusively online, with 100 bags released daily at 12:00 p.m. EST until September 16. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:d0dfbe8f9bc4a4af.title: The Nike Air Max Goadome "Black/Volt" Blacks Out Everything but a Single ACG Badge
a4977d3fa4:d0dfbe8f9bc4a4af.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:d0dfbe8f9bc4a4af.summary: Name: Nike Air Max Goadome “Black/Volt”Colorway: Black/Anthracite-VoltSKU: IQ7198-001MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: Fall 2026Nike is lining up a new "Black/Volt" treatment of the Air Max Goadome, and the appeal of this one is almost entirely in the surfaces. The boot's upper pairs black and Anthracite leather in two different finishes, setting smooth panels against textured sections around the sides and collar so the tonal palette still reads with depth. It is a build that asks to be examined up close rather than clocked from across a room.The commitment to tonality is close to total. Laces, eyelets, tongue, stitching and sole all sit in the same register, which leaves the boot without the usual visual breaks that separate a Goadome's component parts. Small silver Swooshes on the lateral sides are the only concession to contrast on the upper, and they are scaled down enough that they register as hardware rather than branding.Underneath, the construction does the talking. Visible Air cushioning is worked into both the heel and the forefoot, giving the silhouette impact protection at both ends rather than at the rear alone, while the outsole keeps the deep tread pattern the model is known for. The one deliberate break in the blackout is a Volt ACG badge sitting on the sole, positioned so the color reads only from certain angles. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:4a789247653f0c1b.title: Proenza Schouler SS27 Reshapes Sharp Tailoring With Cowling, Cyanotype Roses and a Rounder PS1
a4977d3fa4:4a789247653f0c1b.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:4a789247653f0c1b.summary: Summary Proenza Schouler has presented its Spring 2027 women's collection, designed by Rachel Scott around the idea that clothes should adapt to the body rather than the reverseCowling, rounded hips and traced seaming soften the label's sharper lines, while a tiger motif runs through silk plissé intarsia, hand-knit intarsia and sequin tuftingThe PS1 Walker debuts as a pared-back evolution of the house bag, keeping the signature latch and belts in a softer, rounder shape Proenza Schouler has unveiled its Spring 2027 women's collection, a season Rachel Scott has assembled almost entirely out of technique. The premise is a New York one, where a gown can read as casual and a casual piece can pass for eveningwear, and the clothes are engineered to accommodate that looseness rather than impose on it. Cowling and rounded hips introduce softness and volume where the label's lines would usually stay sharp, and seaming is used to trace the body across dresses, effectively laying one silhouette over another.The knitwear is where the construction talks loudest. Sunburst pointelle opens into angular flanges at the hip, stripes twist and swirl their way around the body, and merino knits are given the same torque so they sit a little undone. Color is handled with equal deliberation: strong hues are set against one another, sheer layers overlap to generate new shades, and fluorescent pink cotton velvet is used for its ability to swallow light rather than bounce it. On denim, an archival garment-printing technique lays white over ecru for a finish closer to canvas than to indigo.Craft carries the collection's two motifs. The tiger is worked three ways, through silk plissé intarsia, hand-knit intarsia and tufting studded with sequins, giving the same image three completely different surfaces. The rose, the only flower in the collection and one the house reads as both feminist and political, is handled through cyanotype, with real roses used to produce the prints before they are…

a4977d3fa4:ca5d97d210cdcbc8.title: Zheng Qinwen’s Nike Zoom Vapor 12 PE Wraps a Comeback Season in Triple Red and Gold
a4977d3fa4:ca5d97d210cdcbc8.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:ca5d97d210cdcbc8.summary: Name: Zheng Qinwen Nike Zoom Vapor 12 PEColorway: University Red/Tough Red-Picante Red-Metallic GoldSKU: IQ9093-600MSRP: TBCRelease Date: TBCNike has produced a Zoom Vapor 12 player exclusive for Zheng Qinwen, handed to the tennis player after her quarterfinal run at the 2026 US Open. The women's PE is built on a red base with gold accents, and every graphic on it is doing narrative work rather than sitting there for decoration. It arrives at a point in Zheng's career that the shoe is clearly designed to mark, following a previous season in which injuries kept her from building any real momentum.The color work is the first thing to register. Rather than settling on a single red, the PE layers University Red, Tough Red and Picante Red so the upper shifts in tone across its panels, and a gold Swoosh supplies the contrast. "Qinwen" branding appears at both the tongue and the heel, placing her name at the two points a player and a broadcast camera are most likely to see it.The graphic package is split between printing and stitching, which gives the motifs different weights on the shoe. A crown, a medal and a set of wings run across the design, three symbols that read less as generic sports iconography than as a shorthand for what the last two seasons have asked of her. Completing the package is a gold phoenix hangtag, the most direct statement on the shoe, carrying associations of renewal and rebirth that Nike has tied explicitly to her return to competitive tennis.The timing supports the reading. Zheng took the PE after reaching the quarterfinals at Flushing Meadows, a run that included wins over two players ranked inside the world's top 25, which is exactly the kind of result that resets a narrative about a player coming back from injury. a4977d3fa4:d5e507f06f4a78f6.title: Rocket Audi Pour the TT's Design Language Into a Dual-Boiler Espresso Machine
a4977d3fa4:d5e507f06f4a78f6.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:d5e507f06f4a78f6.summary: Summary Rocket Espresso and Audi have co-developed a prosumer espresso machine built on the Rocket Bicocca portafilter platformThe design was worked up with the Audi Design Team and studio Valerio Cometti + V12Design, taking the Audi TT as its reference pointInside sit dual stainless-steel boilers, a rotary pump and PID control on an electrically heated brewing group Rocket Espresso and Audi have built an espresso machine together, and the engineering underneath it is as considered as the bodywork. The machine takes Rocket's Bicocca portafilter platform as its base and runs it through Audi's design language, with the finished unit pairing with a Spluga grinder developed specifically to sit alongside it. Development was shared between the Audi Design Team and Italian studio Valerio Cometti + V12Design, working from the Audi TT as the visual touchstone.Two stainless-steel boilers handle brewing and steam separately, sized at 0.5 liters and 1.5 liters respectively, and a rotary pump supplies pressure rather than the vibration pumps that sit in cheaper machines. PID temperature control is applied to an electrically heated brewing group, which is the specification that matters most for shot-to-shot consistency. The unit draws 1,600W across both 220 to 240V and 115V configurations, holds 1.8 liters in the tank and weighs 35 kg across a 409 by 465 by 400 mm footprint.Control is where the car influence becomes functional rather than cosmetic. A 3.5-inch touchscreen is recessed into the upper section of the brewing unit, running a textless HMI interface that leans on symbols instead of written menus, while black glossy handles and rotary controls provide the tactile counterpoint. It is a division of labor familiar from a car interior, with the physical controls kept for the actions you perform by feel.Matte aluminum is set against deep black surfaces, and the side panels rise progressively toward the rear in a sculpted geometry that gives the machine a directional stance…

a4977d3fa4:5b8f17a83bdc3bcd.title: Sandy Liang SS27 Sends Ruffled Track Pants and Trompe l'Oeil Skirts to Versailles
a4977d3fa4:5b8f17a83bdc3bcd.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5b8f17a83bdc3bcd.summary: Summary Sandy Liang has presented its Spring/Summer 2027 runway collection, built around modularity and the idea of dressing for your own whimsPrincess detailing runs through the sportswear, with a ruffle set over the seat of track pants and dolphins kissing across the back of a track jacketAccessories carry the season, from bunny shoes with gemstone eyes to leg warmers trailing ribbons and hair clips arranged like a bouquet Sandy Liang has unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 runway collection, a season the label frames around getting dolled up specifically in order to run around. The premise is modularity and functionality treated as a daydream rather than a constraint, with each season understood as another part of the Sandy girl's closet being opened up. Familiar objects come back altered, the design logic being that everyday things and memories can be reconsidered rather than replaced.The detailing is where that idea gets literal. A ruffle is positioned over the seat of a pair of track pants, dolphins kiss across the back of a track jacket, and lace is finished with clear paillettes so the fabric catches light as the wearer moves. Trompe l'oeil skirts state their own intentions rather than hiding the trick, while a soft V-neck sweater is cut just low enough to register as deliberate. Tailored workwear and white patent-leather wedges pull the collection back toward something more serious.Bags and shoes carry the same tension between usefulness and excess. A gorp-fantasy bag arrives stamped with a "Sandy Liang X3000" logo, placing nostalgia and futurism in the same object, and a purse is fitted with more pockets than could realistically be filled. Even a miniature bag is organized so everything has a designated spot. Vibrant ballet shoes borrow their shape from house slippers, bunny shoes are set with gemstone eyes, leg warmers trail streaming ribbons, and a large sash is treated as the piece that finishes an outfit on the basis that days and nights are worth…

fc066e842d:39259eaee8076066.title: Diffusion of tacit knowledge in a company: a mathematical model based on diffusion on graphs
fc066e842d:39259eaee8076066.author: Andrzej Buszko
fc066e842d:39259eaee8076066.summary: This article is devoted to the process of diffusing tacit knowledge. This intangible asset has proven crucial for achieving a competitive advantage among market-oriented companies. A novel model of tacit knowledge diffusion is presented, employing the concept of heat diffusion from physics. Furthermore, graph theory and the dynamics it defines are utilized. We defined a Tacit Knowledge Transfer Graph that encodes data from questionnaires. It enables us to identify employees' learning needs, allowing for the planning of classes within the same period, such as a day, to schedule them optimally. Moreover, the model can be used to identify employees with high knowledge demands. The application is not limited to companies; a simple example of planning classes in a school/university is provided. The presented model can help with optimal scheduling, enhance operational efficiency, and improve talent management within the company. It can also identify risks associated with critical sources of knowledge and help improve organizational culture and knowledge management policy.

fc066e842d:e0ba07a8dbabc318.title: Corporate research and value creation in Peru
fc066e842d:e0ba07a8dbabc318.author: Iglesias-Osores, Sebastian
fc066e842d:e0ba07a8dbabc318.summary: This working paper develops a conceptual and contextual framework for understanding corporate research in Peru as a value-creation capability rather than as an activity mainly induced by public grants or tax incentives. The central argument is that public innovation funds and tax benefits can accelerate business innovation, but they cannot substitute for the internal routines through which firms learn, document, protect, and capture value from knowledge. Drawing on the resource-based view, the knowledge-based theory of the firm, absorptive capacity, dynamic capabilities, open innovation, technological capability accumulation in emerging economies, and the appropriability literature, the paper proposes an integrated pathway linking corporate research, structured learning, firm-specific know-how, appropriability decisions, innovation capability, and economic value capture. The argument is situated in the Peruvian context through indicators of low R&D intensity, public information on Law No. 30309, patenting evidence, and sectoral illustrative cases. The paper contributes by reframing public innovation instruments as levers of pre-existing capabilities rather than substitutes for strategy, and by offering a practical maturity framework for managers seeking to transform research activities into intangible assets, technical reputation, and new sources of income.

fc066e842d:631be1e5c2625b54.title: ORONER: An Ontology for Representing interOrganizational Networks Resilience. A building block towards adaptive network reconfiguration
fc066e842d:631be1e5c2625b54.author: Éric Saux
fc066e842d:631be1e5c2625b54.summary: Organizations are regularly affected by crises (e.g., pandemics, financial crises, natural disasters) to which they must respond appropriately in order to maintain their functioning and prevent decline and failure. A possible direction to achieve this is to develop their resilience in order to mitigate, anticipate, respond to and recover from adversity through the creation of interorganizational networks. This article aims to contribute to the understanding and modeling of how a network of interdependent organizations can collectively develop their resilience and how to infer the possible resource sharing between them. This study is undertaken through a strong coupling between social sciences (organization studies) and computer sciences (knowledge representation). We propose an ontological model, named ORONER, which is able to represent such organizational networks configurations with two future objectives: (1) analyzing the resources distribution within a network over a crisis period, and (2) reorganizing it to develop collective resilience. This domain ontology is based on the consideration of knowledge about organizations: the missions, interactions, crisis management, spatial-temporal entities as well as human and material resources necessary to operate organizations. Concepts are formalized using description logic and a set of rules is defined to infer some possible resource sharing. The evaluation of ORONER is performed through a case study and a list of competency questions, which exhibit initial and inferred interactions between organizations (e.g., municipalities, hospitals and schools) during the COVID-19 crisis.

5b51167fb0:140613fdcd625616.title: Presidential Address: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
5b51167fb0:140613fdcd625616.author: info@aeaweb.org (Lawrence F. Katz1 1 Harvard University (email: lkatz@harvard.edu))
5b51167fb0:140613fdcd625616.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3197-3222 Abstract Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children's adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an undersupply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children's future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children. (JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38)

5b51167fb0:efb7cbbe3071ae07.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
5b51167fb0:efb7cbbe3071ae07.author: info@aeaweb.org (Andreas Haupt1 and Zoë Hitzig2 1 Stanford Digital Economy Lab (email: h4upt@stanford.edu) 2 Harvard Society of Fellows (email: zhitzig@g.harvard.edu))
5b51167fb0:efb7cbbe3071ae07.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3223-3262 Abstract A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions. (JEL D44, D82)

5b51167fb0:1a15b1cd2416f9fe.author: info@aeaweb.org (Daniel Björkegren1, Joshua E. Blumenstock2 and Samsun Knight3 1 Columbia University (email: dan@bjorkegren.com) 2 UC Berkeley (email: jblumenstock@berkeley.edu) 3 University of…
5b51167fb0:1a15b1cd2416f9fe.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3263-3293 Abstract An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress-test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO. (JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16)

5b51167fb0:a1ffa58aef64f33d.title: Risk-Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
5b51167fb0:a1ffa58aef64f33d.author: info@aeaweb.org (Ethan Ligon1 1 University of California, Berkeley (email: ligon@berkeley.edu))
5b51167fb0:a1ffa58aef64f33d.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3294-3329 Abstract Efficient risk sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). I describe all preferences that permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial. (JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12)

5b51167fb0:797852c7470100e9.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World's Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
5b51167fb0:797852c7470100e9.author: info@aeaweb.org (Gabriel Kreindler1, Arya Gaduh2, Tilman Graff3, Rema Hanna4 and Benjamin A. Olken5 1 Harvard University (email: gkreindler@g.harvard.edu) 2 University of Arkansas (email:…
5b51167fb0:797852c7470100e9.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3330-3379 Abstract Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait-time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2–3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare. (JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48)

5b51167fb0:07fc24e40491cd16.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
5b51167fb0:07fc24e40491cd16.author: info@aeaweb.org (Patrick J. Kennedy1, Christine L. Dobridge2, Paul Landefeld3 and Jacob Mortenson4 1 UCLA, NBER, and JCT (email: pkennedy@econ.ucla.edu) 2 Federal Reserve Board (email:…
5b51167fb0:07fc24e40491cd16.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3380-3422 Abstract We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in US history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their preexisting legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short run, 87 percent of private income gains flow to the top 10 percent of the income distribution. (JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25)

5b51167fb0:3ee043839f43fb4e.title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
5b51167fb0:3ee043839f43fb4e.author: info@aeaweb.org (Alberto Bisin1 and Giulia Tura2 1 New York University (email: alberto.bisin@nyu.edu) 2 LUISS University (email: gtura@luiss.it))
5b51167fb0:3ee043839f43fb4e.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3423-3463 Abstract We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intrahousehold investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic-group-specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants' cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children's education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial—though heterogeneous—cultural integration rates across immigrant groups. (JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13)

5b51167fb0:26e7d435f0796a13.title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
5b51167fb0:26e7d435f0796a13.author: info@aeaweb.org (Amanda Dahlstrand1 1 University of Zurich (email: amanda.dahlstrand@econ.uzh.ch))
5b51167fb0:26e7d435f0796a13.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3464-3509 Abstract Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online health care, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4 percent (SE 1.3); reallocations also reduce Counter-Guideline antibiotics by 3.1 percent (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching; horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted. (JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18)

5b51167fb0:221f12c25326ebda.title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
5b51167fb0:221f12c25326ebda.author: info@aeaweb.org (Luigi Iovino1, Thorsten Martin2 and Julien Sauvagnat3 1 Bocconi University (email: luigi.iovino@unibocconi.it) 2 Frankfurt School of Finance and Management (email: t.martin@fs.de) 3…
5b51167fb0:221f12c25326ebda.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3510-3551 Abstract We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the United States. We show CO2-intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58)

5b51167fb0:273a7079633c9788.title: Rationing by Race
5b51167fb0:273a7079633c9788.author: info@aeaweb.org (Manasvini Singh1 and Atheendar Venkataramani2 1 Carnegie Mellon University and NBER (email: msingh01@cmu.edu) 2 University of Pennsylvania and NBER (email:…
5b51167fb0:273a7079633c9788.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3552-3585 Abstract We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a high-stakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black but not White patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism. (JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

5b51167fb0:b142b734d632b9cc.title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
5b51167fb0:b142b734d632b9cc.author: info@aeaweb.org (Esther Duflo1, Pascaline Dupas2, Elizabeth Spelke3 and Mark Walsh4 1 MIT and Collège de France (email: eduflo@mit.edu) 2 Princeton University (email: pdupas@princeton.edu) 3 Harvard…
5b51167fb0:b142b734d632b9cc.summary: American Economic Review 116 (9): 3586-3621 Abstract We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies, and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age five among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high-return investment, with a conservatively estimated US$4.1 in benefits for each US$1 the policy would cost the government in the long run. (JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15)

21113a7a19:8562b73267220857.title: Experimenting on the psychology of LLMs
21113a7a19:8562b73267220857.author: Al Roth (noreply@blogger.com)
21113a7a19:8562b73267220857.summary: As LLMs become increasingly important, we're starting to see experiments that explore their psychology. (I expect that Susan Calvin, who was Isaac Asimov's fictional robopsychologist from the1950 short story collection I Robot , will soon have scientists following in her footsteps.) Note that experiments intended to explore A.I. psychology need not necessarily resemble those intended to explore human psychology. Here's an example, from the journal Artificial Intelligence and the Law: Human realignment: An empirical study of LLMs as legal decision-aids in moral dilemmas by Christoph Engel · Yoan Hermstrüwer · Alison Kim Abstract: Recent advances in AI make it conceivable to delegate legal decision-making to machines, or to enhance human adjudication through AI assistance. Using classic normative conflicts — the trolley problem and comparable moral dilemmas — as a proof of concept, we examine the alignment between AI legal reasoning and human judgment. In our baseline experiment, we find a pronounced mismatch between decisions made by GPT and those of human subjects. This misalignment raises substantive concerns for AI-powered legal decision-aids. We investigate whether explicit normative guidance can address this misalignment, with mixed results. GPT-3.5 is susceptible to such intervention, but frequently refuses to decide when faced with a moral dilemma. GPT-4 is outright utilitarian, and essentially ignores the instruction to decide on deontological grounds. GPT-o3-mini faithfully implements this instruction, but is unwilling to balance deontological and utilitarian concerns if instructed to do so. We replicate the experiment with four LLMs from different providers. Claude-sonnet-4.6 comes closest to human respondents. Gemini-2.5-flash-lite is most sensitive to normative instructions. Llama-4-scout and Mistral-nemo have a strong utilitarian bias, and do not strongly respond to normative interventions. At least for the time being, explicit normative instructions…

21113a7a19:31ba3d7f9c2dc17a.title: Surrogacy (on each side of the Atlantic)
21113a7a19:31ba3d7f9c2dc17a.author: Al Roth (noreply@blogger.com)
21113a7a19:31ba3d7f9c2dc17a.summary: Crossing the Atlantic today, to return home from Paris, this story in The Atlantic seems apropos: Mothers for Sale. Most of Europe bans commercial surrogacy. The United Nations likens it to slavery. But in the United States, business is booming. By Helen Lewis "Since the legalization of same-sex marriage, male couples have become the big growth market for American surrogacy, but the practice is booming among aspiring parents—married or single, straight or gay—who can afford the cost of hiring someone else to carry their child. In 2024, 11,821 embryos were transferred to surrogates in American clinics associated with the Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology, up from 8,461 three years earlier, and the United Nations estimates that the global worth of the industry is almost $15 billion. Most surrogacy in America today is commercial, meaning that the carrier is paid, and gestational, meaning that the carrier has no genetic relationship to the child. ... " many liberal Americans are surprised to discover that their country is an outlier in its enthusiasm for commercial surrogacy. In Britain, where I live, a ban on the practice enjoys substantial support among feminists, who worry about the power differential between paid surrogates and wealthy would-be parents. (Altruistic surrogacy, in which the surrogate carries a baby solely out of generosity, is less controversial and is permitted.) A recent UN report went even further, declaring that commercial surrogacy “constitutes the sale of children, which is a crime,” and that “surrogacy arrangements can amount to or resemble slavery.” ... "Because so much can go wrong, every country in the European Union has banned commercial surrogacy. France’s centrist liberal president, Emmanuel Macron, has described the practice as “not compatible with the dignity of women.” Italy’s right-wing populist leader, Giorgia Meloni, has enacted one of the strictest anti-surrogacy frameworks in the world. 21113a7a19:c56640781616b6c7.title: Xenotransplants will substitute for dialysis before they replace human kidney transplants
21113a7a19:c56640781616b6c7.author: Al Roth (noreply@blogger.com)
21113a7a19:c56640781616b6c7.summary: Transplants of organs from genetically modified pigs to humans is making progress, but pig organs haven't yet survived long enough to be a viable substitute for human organs. Kidneys are a good experimental organ to work with, because when the pig organ fails, the patient can go back on dialysis (and continue to wait for a deceased-donor organ transplant). But if pig organs can last long enough, they might replace dialysis. The first pig-organ recipient to go straight to a human organ transplant has now been reported, in a press release accompanying the case report. Below are both the press release and the case report. Patient Who Received Pig Kidney Becomes First To Progress to Human Kidney Transplant Study shows xenotransplantation can serve as a bridge for patients with end-stage kidney disease By MASS GENERAL BRIGHAM COMMUNICATIONS September 3, 2026 Riella L, Borges T, Rosales I et al. Porcine kidney xenotransplantation as a bridge to allotransplantation: a first-in-human study The Lancet, 2026; "This case shows that porcine kidney xenotransplantation can provide prolonged renal support and be discontinued without clinically significant allosensitisation or zoonotic infection. Early cellular rejection resolved with treatment, whereas later graft failure was associated with microvascular injury progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite a negative donor-specific crossmatch, supporting the possibility that mechanisms beyond conventional antibody-mediated rejection contributed to late graft injury. Kidney xenotransplantation has the potential to provide prolonged dialysis-free support while also serving as a bridge to subsequent human allotransplantation ."

21113a7a19:2c743f5c371780f9.title: How to Get Away with Merger in a Dialysis Duopoly by T.G. Wollman
21113a7a19:2c743f5c371780f9.author: Al Roth (noreply@blogger.com)
21113a7a19:2c743f5c371780f9.summary: Here's a paper featured by Microeconomic Insights, which shows that in the highly concentrated dialysis market, in which prices are mostly federally regulated, mergers reduce competition on quality. Thomas G. Wollmann: How to Get Away with Merger: Stealth Consolidation and Its Effects on US Dialysis "This paper studies premerger notification of US dialysis acquisitions from 1996 to 2017. Like many industries, dialysis has consolidated rapidly. During this period, thousands of facilities changed ownership, yet only half were reported to federal antitrust authorities. Unlike most industries, dialysis prices are mostly set by the government, so acquisitions of rival facilities reduce the incentive to compete on quality. Since patients are often already in poor health, preventing stealth consolidation could save lives. The study combines data on market structure, antitrust enforcement, and patient health. I begin by describing patterns in the data. Next, I estimate a structural model of dialysis competition, enforcement, and agency costs. Finally, I use the estimates to predict what would have happened had all dialysis mergers proposed during the study period been reportable. Three main findings emerge. Premerger notification is critical to effective antitrust enforcement. All else equal, exemption reduces the likelihood of enforcement by about 90%. Exempt acquisitions that concentrate ownership degrade quality, as evidenced by higher postmerger hospitalization and mortality rates. The benefits of expanding premerger notification exceed the costs by orders of magnitude. This reflects the deterrence effect of antitrust enforcement (i.e., rivals won’t try to merge if they know their deal will be blocked) as well as the efficiency of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC), which polices billions of dollars of dialysis transactions with very few resources."
